FILED s510 (Fable, 2026-10-06) from the perf round 40 review probes (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s510/review/p40/z.pl, and p.pl rows 79-80); main 9364ae68.
  { local $, = 0;   print "A", "B" }     perl: A0B     PCL: AB
  { local $\ = 0;   print "C" }          perl: C0      PCL: C
  { local $, = 0;   say "I", "J" }       perl: I0J     PCL: IJ
  RIGHT: `$, = "0"`, `$\ = "0"`, `$" = 0` ("@a" -> 102), `$; = 0`, `$/ = 0`.
CAUSE (not read, the cheap guess to confirm first): the separator read in %p-write-list tests the value for TRUTH or for a numeric zero where perl tests DEFINEDNESS -- one predicate, shared by print and say.  s510p (perf round 40) edited that function for #2771 B1; this is in the same lines.

=== WHERE (s510p, read on 1df430b9) ===
cl/pcl-runtime.lisp %p-write-list: line 16227 `(ofs (let ((v (unbox |$,|))) (and (stringp v) (plusp (length v)) v)))` and line 16235 `(when (and (stringp ors) (plusp (length ors))) ...)` -- both separators are tested with STRINGP, so a NUMBER (0, or any number) in $, / $\ is treated as unset.  perl stringifies a defined separator.  Not changed by s510p.


=== DONE (s510b, Opus 5.5; commits 58aa3845 + cad44433 on the s510b branch, rebased s512) ===
One helper %p-separator-text for $, and $\ (print and say): a separator is used when DEFINED, stringifying the BOX (so an object's "" overload is its text).  Every value probed vs perl (0 0.0 1 0.5 "0" "" undef, ref, overload, local, printf) identical.  ir-spec 8, the $\ / $, row.  Guard Pl/t/print-fh-magic-01.t 37 -> 38 rows.  Perf: the out-of-line helper cost fhprint +10.5 % (control -0.2 %); cad44433 made it inline with an undef-first fast path, re-bench within the control band (+3.6 / +0.1 % vs +1.6 / -0.4 %).  Residue filed: #2850 (tied $, FETCH count; a tie on $\).
subject: SILENT WRONG, small (pre-existing): `$, = 0` and `$\ = 0` (the NUMBER zero) are ignored by print / say -- perl prints `A0B` and `C0`, PCL `AB` and `C`; the string "0" works
